skills.description: This skill should be used whenever the user sends one or more Etsy listing URLs (containing etsy.com/listing/ or similar formats), or provides Etsy CSV data files for analysis. It automates the full competitor analysis workflow: launching Chrome with the user's local cookies to bypass anti-bot protection, extracting the fully-rendered page HTML via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), parsing product data from JSON-LD structured data, and generating comprehensive HTML competitor analysis reports.
